::: {.lead}

I work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and knowledge representation. My focus is extracting interpretable knowledge from complex data, with a particular interest in decision-support systems.

:::

I belong to the {{< meta profile.team >}} team at the CEDRIC laboratory.

Previously, I studied mathematics and artificial intelligence at École normale supérieure de Lyon.

:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}

## Initial thesis title

**Neuro-symbolic rule extraction for governance and careers at the medieval University of Paris from a prosopographical knowledge graph.**

A central challenge is to assess what extracted rules mean when the underlying historical evidence is incomplete, ambiguous or contradictory. I am interested in connecting computational patterns with explanations that historians can assess in their documentary and historical context.

:::
